The British General 9-way consumer unit distributes electrical power safely throughout residential or commercial properties. This unit is ideal for professional electricians installing modern distribution boards in domestic retrofits and extensions. Supplied part-populated with 6 x Type A RCBOs and a pre-wired 100A main switch, this board saves valuable installation time on site. The integrated Type 2 SPD safeguards household circuits against transient overvoltages, while individual RCBO protection ensures that electrical faults only isolate the affected circuit, minimising overall disruption. A robust steel enclosure provides durability.
b: 6 x Type A RCBOs ( 2 x 6A, 1 x 16A, 2 x 32A & 1 x 40A)
Top, Bottom, Left, Right & Rear Cable Entry Points

Individual RCBOs Limit Disruption from Faults
